rules.statement: The business of life insurance is expressly exempted from VAT.
rules.supporting_quote: This Court is of the view that the VAT Act itself expressly provides for the exemption of the business of life insurance from the charge of VAT.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 25C(5)(a) of the VAT Act, PART II (b)(x)(i) of the First schedule to the VAT Act
